extracted.intended_audience: CIA management, Special Security Center staff, and US Intelligence Community security managers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for implementing OMB Circular A-44 within the Agency, focusing on management effectiveness for compartmented security control systems and expectations about cost-reduction for FY 1971. Targets Agency/security managers responsible for protecting highly sensitive intelligence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Effectiveness Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide security policy, direction and guidance to the US Intelligence Community on three compartmented security control systems established to protect sensitive intelligence sources and methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes providing guidance to relevant organizational elements on policy matters and the controls employed to protect highly sensitive US intelligence. (Original text references 'three compartmented security control systems' and protecting 'sensitive intelligence sources and 25X1 methods'; some material is redacted.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance on Policy Matters and Controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide guidance to the [organizational element] on policy matters and controls employed to protect highly sensitive US intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is presented as part of management effectiveness: officers must offer policy direction and specify controls for protection of highly sensitive intelligence. (Portion of the recipient/office is redacted in the source.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost-Reduction Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless there is a policy change at the highest level affecting the classification of compartmented programs, it is not expected that there will be any earnings measurably in dollars or manpower for FY 1971.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets the expectation that measurable dollar or manpower savings are unlikely for FY 1971 absent high-level policy changes on classification; implies cost-reduction efforts should consider classification constraints when estimating potential savings.
